data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'malakah', meaning 'queen' or 'lady'. In Islamic tradition, 'malakah' also refers to the female angels who carry out Allah's commands. The name Melek carries the meaning “Queen, Lady” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Melek usually hope their child will grow to embody queen, lady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
